import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap; long cost;
        Edge rev;
        public Edge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            this.src = src; this.dst = dst; this.cap = cap; this.cost = cost;
        }
    }
    static class MinCostFlow {
        List<Edge>[] adj;
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp, ptnl, dist;
        Edge[] last;
        int n;
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

        public MinCostFlow(int size) {
            this.n = size;
            adj = new ArrayList[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            minCost = 0; totalCost = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            Edge e1 = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost);
            e1.rev = e2;
            e2.rev = e1;
            adj[src].add(e1);
            adj[dst].add(e2);
        }

        void supply(int node, long vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean solve() {
            int S = n - 2;
            int T = n - 1;
            supp = new long[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            last = new Edge[n];

            long suppSum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                suppSum += supp[i];
            }

            for (;;) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                dist[S] = 0;
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, S});
                boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];

                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] p = pq.poll();
                    long ndist = p[0]; int now = (int) p[1];
                    if (visited[now]) continue;
                    visited[now] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[now]) {
                        if (e.cap <= 0 || dist[e.dst] + ptnl[now] > dist[e.dst] + ptnl[e.dst]) continue;
                        if (dist[now] + e.cost < dist[e.dst]) {
                            dist[e.dst] = dist[now] + e.cost;
                            last[e.dst] = e;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                        }
                    }
                }
                boolean reachable = false;
                if (dist[T] != INF) {
                    long flow = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (Edge e = last[T]; e != null; e = last[e.src]) {
                        flow = Math.min(flow, e.cap);
                    }
                    totalCost += flow * dist[T];
                    for (Edge e = last[T]; e != null; e = last[e.src]) {
                        e.cap -= flow;
                        e.rev.cap += flow;
                    }
                    minCost += dist[T] * flow;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        long getMinCost() {
            solve();
            return minCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int tlim = 105;
        // Initialize min cost flow with size = 6100 + 2 (to handle nodes and auxiliary nodes)
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100 + 2);

        long[] supplyArr = new long[6100 + 2];
        Arrays.fill(supplyArr, 0);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            supplyArr[j]++;
        }

        // Assign supplies
        for (int i = 0; i < 6102; i++) {
            mcf.supply(i, supplyArr[i]);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;

            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, d * (2 * x + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, d * (2 * x + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }

        int dst = 6100; 
        // Add sink node
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }

        System.out.println(mcf.getMinCost());
    }
}
